summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Supreme features: Messaging (WhatsApp/SMS) configuration, Email templates system, and Automatic reports generation. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Institution Settings has 7 tabs (AI, Avatar, Zoom, Email, SMS, Reports, XP), SMS tab shows WhatsApp/SMS configuration with provider selection (Twilio/MessageBird/Vonage), Reports tab shows weekly/monthly toggle, delivery day, content options, and Generate Report Now button that displays results.
passed_tests: GET /api/institution/messaging/config - Returns messaging configuration (provider, enabled, sms_enabled, whatsapp_enabled)
POST /api/institution/messaging/config - Save messaging configuration with provider, API keys, phone numbers
GET /api/institution/reports/config - Returns reports configuration (weekly_enabled, monthly_enabled, delivery_day, etc.)
GET /api/institution/reports/generate?report_type=weekly - Generate weekly report with engagement, AI usage, exam stats
GET /api/institution/email-templates - Returns default email templates (welcome, exam_reminder, progress_report)
POST /api/institution/email-templates/preview - Preview template with sample data (placeholders replaced)
POST /api/institution/messaging/test - Test SMS endpoint (MOCKED - simulates sending)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Supreme features fully tested: 1) Messaging Config: GET/POST /api/institution/messaging/config works, supports Twilio/MessageBird/Vonage providers, test endpoint is MOCKED (no actual SMS/WhatsApp sent). 2) Email Templates: GET returns 3 default templates (welcome, exam_reminder, progress_report), POST saves custom templates, preview replaces placeholders with sample data. 3) Reports: GET/POST config works, generate endpoint creates weekly/monthly reports with engagement stats, AI usage, exam stats. Frontend Institution Settings has 7 tabs all working correctly.

mocked_apis_list: POST /api/institution/messaging/test - simulates sending test message (no actual Twilio/MessageBird call)
POST /api/institution/messaging/send-bulk - queues messages but doesn't actually send

backend.messaging_config: GET/POST /api/institution/messaging/config - provider selection, API keys, phone numbers
backend.reports_config: GET/POST /api/institution/reports/config - weekly/monthly toggles, delivery day, content options
backend.reports_generate: GET /api/institution/reports/generate - weekly/monthly report generation with stats

frontend.institution_settings_tabs: 7 tabs: AI, Avatar, Zoom, Email, SMS, Reports, XP
frontend.sms_tab: WhatsApp & SMS Configuration with Enable Messaging toggle, Provider selection (Twilio/MessageBird/Vonage), API credentials inputs, phone number inputs, Enable SMS/WhatsApp toggles, Test Message section
frontend.reports_tab: Automatic Reports with Weekly/Monthly toggles, Report Delivery Day dropdown, Report Contents (AI Usage Stats, Exam Statistics, Student Engagement), Recipients (Institution Admins, Students), Generate Report Now buttons, Generated Report display

mobile_screens_note: Mobile screens (AITutorScreen.tsx, LiveClassesScreen.tsx, ExamStartScreen.tsx) are React Native TypeScript components - not testable in browser. These are for mobile app only.
